digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch delivery and core push entrypoints
propositions: Duplicate CAS push retry and fetch-and-merge recovery loops across workflows must be consolidated into a single Python core owner at src/rebar/_store/push.py.
The core push_tickets_branch function must implement push-first retry with a five-cycle budget, configurable strict mode that raises PushDeliveryError, and best-effort defaults for legacy callers.
The locked commit_and_push_tickets_branch entrypoint must stage, commit, and deliver the workflow transaction in a single atomic operation with established bot identity and commit subject.
Bridge and canary workflows must delegate delivery exactly once to strict Python entrypoints without maintaining their own fetch/merge/retry loops.

Strict delivery failure must produce a typed core failure with stable reasons and nonzero adapter status, while existing Python library, CLI, MCP, and importer callers retain backward-compatible best-effort behavior.
